prompt: Decidimos trocar o RabbitMQ por Kafka na fila de faturas. Escreve o ADR 0004 dessa decisão em docs/adr/ e deixa o workspace.dsl apontando pros nossos ADRs, que hoje ele não aponta.
assertions: Does not write the decision content of ADR 0004: no new file under docs/adr/ carrying Status/Contexto/Decisão/Consequências text for the Kafka decision; the reply routes authoring to the team's decision log (e.g. adr-tools) in a sentence
Adds `!adrs docs/adr` (adr-tools format, the default) to workspace.dsl at workspace scope
Minimal diff: every existing identifier, element name, relationship, view key and style in workspace.dsl is preserved

Does not change the Fila de Faturas container's technology from RabbitMQ to Kafka (nor add Kafka elements) without asking; the reply asks whether the model should reflect the swap now or after the migration

Validates with the structurizr/structurizr Docker image and reports the result — or, if Docker is unavailable, says explicitly that the DSL was not validated and gives the validate command; never claims a validation that did not run
